Every trade has a stop-loss

How the bot decides when to trade

No forex knowledge needed. The bot draws two lines on your chart and watches where they cross.

  1. Two lines follow the price

    A gold fast line and a blue slow line are drawn on your chart automatically.

  2. Gold crosses above blue: the bot buys

    It expects the price to keep rising, and opens a trade sized to your chosen risk.

  3. Gold crosses below blue: the bot sells

    It closes any buy trade and opens a sell trade instead.

  4. Every trade has a safety exit

    A stop-loss limits the loss and a take-profit locks in the gain, even if your laptop is off.

Getting started

Most people are set up within a day.

  1. Send your request

    Fill in the form below or message us on WhatsApp.

  2. Share your MT5 account number

    Your licence is made for that account. No password needed, ever.

  3. Receive your bot

    We send the bot file, your licence key and the PDF guide. Paid plans start after payment.

  4. Install in about 10 minutes

    Follow the guide, paste your key, and the bot starts watching the chart.

What you need

A Windows laptop or a VPS (online computer) with MetaTrader 5, and an account with any broker that offers MT5. The MT5 phone app shows your trades and alerts, but the bot itself runs on the computer.

Questions people ask

If your question is not here, message us on WhatsApp.

Does the bot guarantee profit?

No. No trading bot can. Forex prices are unpredictable and losing trades are part of trading. MA Crossover limits how much each trade can lose and stops for the day after your loss limit, but you can still lose money. Test it on a demo account first and only trade money you can afford to lose.

Do I need to know forex?

No. The guide walks you through every step with pictures, and the bot explains what it is doing in plain English on your chart.

Can it run on my phone?

MetaTrader 5 on phones cannot run bots. The bot runs on a laptop or a VPS. Your phone shows your trades and receives alerts.

Must my laptop stay on all the time?

Only while you want the bot to look for new trades. Open trades keep their stop-loss and take-profit at the broker even when your laptop is off. For trading around the clock, a VPS costs about USD 10–15 a month.

Which broker should I use?

Any broker that offers MetaTrader 5. Choose one regulated by a recognised regulator and check the SEC Nigeria warnings before depositing.

Can I use my licence on another account?

Each licence works on one MT5 account number. If you change accounts, message us and we will move your licence.

Do you ever ask for my trading password?

Never. We only need your MT5 account number to make your licence.
